title: perf: upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 with fused ops and rotary optimizations
author: Linus Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce end-to-end token latency and improve throughput for common generation workloads by upgrading the attention execution path. Summary: Integrate FlashAttentionV2 variant for improved memory bandwidth utilization, introduce fused QKV+proj fused CUDA kernels for transformer blocks, and apply rotary/rope computational rework with precomputed rotated bases to avoid redundant device memory traffic. This PR touches the serving runtime scheduler hooks to expose a kernel-selection heuristic (sequence-length and batch-size aware) and adds flags for continuous batching compatibility. The changes include fallbacks to the legacy kernel on unsupported hardware and a runtime self-check to validate numerical parity on a representative micro-batch. Checklist: - Implement FlashAttentionV2 kernels and bindings - Add fused QKV projection kernels with optional int8-friendly codepath - Rework rotary/rope computations to use fused elementwise+cuBLAS calls and precompute rotated bases where beneficial - Extend kernel selection policy with a new heuristic: prefer FA2 for seq_len>=128 and batch>=8 else prefer legacy or FA1 when memory is constrained - Add unit and integration tests (numerical parity, perf smoke) - Update runtime config and expose feature gate for canary rollout - Add microbenchmarks and end-to-end perf test harness entries - Add release notes and migration instructions Compatibility: Default behavior preserves existing results; feature gated rollout enabled per-customer. Rollout plan: staged canary in prod for 10% traffic, then ramp after perf/regression signals pass. Impact: Benchmarks on A100 and H100 show median 20-35% token latency reduction at typical batch shapes and 15-25% throughput improvements across S3-like generation traces. Fallbacks ensure no correctness regressions on older GPUs.

perf(attn): fused qkv+proj kernel implementation and kernel switches
refactor(rotary): precompute rotated bases and fuse with elementwise ops

review_threads: Ava Morgan: Please add an explicit numerical tolerance check for float16 parity on H100 micro-batch shapes. Author: Added parity tests and documented tolerances in test docstring.
Diego Patel: The fused qkv kernel needs a fallback for odd hidden sizes to avoid launch failures. Author: Added branching code path and unit test for odd hidden_size. Diego: approved after fix.

Priya Rao: Concern about memory peaks when precomputing rotated bases for very long sequences. Author: Implemented heuristics to only precompute when seq_len <= 4096 or when estimated memory saving outweighs cost; added a runtime toggle. Priya: requested small doc clarifying heuristic; author updated docs and addressed comment.
CI: build_flashattention failed on first run due to missing cuBLAS version check; author added a runtime check and CI now passes.
SRE: Request to add observability for kernel selection decisions in tracing logs; author added tracing spans to scheduler.
release_notes: Upgrade attention kernels: FlashAttentionV2 integration, fused QKV+proj kernels, rotary/rope optimizations. Performance: 20-35% latency reduction and throughput improvements across A100/H100 for typical workloads. Feature gate enabled for staged rollout. See docs/release_notes/2026-02-28-attn-kernel-upgrade.md for migration and compatibility notes.
